cli.intro: OpenCAD — create, edit and inspect drawings on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create an empty drawing and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a drawing file and print its revision, layers and entities
cmd.undo: Restore the previous document from the file's history sidecar and save it in place
cmd.redo: Reapply the snapshot the last undo replaced and save it in place
cmd.inspect: Run the declared checks on a drawing file
cmd.export: Project a drawing file into an exchange format
cmd.import: Create a new drawing from the ASCII DXF subset (LINE, ARC, ELLIPSE, POINT, INSERT, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, SPLINE, LEADER); approximations and skipped entities are reported as losses
cmd.entity: Edit the entities of an existing drawing file
cmd.arc: Add a circular arc to an existing drawing file
cmd.arc-add: Add a counter-clockwise arc and save the file in place
cmd.ellipse: Add a full or partial ellipse to an existing drawing file
cmd.ellipse-add: Add an ellipse and save the file in place
cmd.transform: Translate, rotate, scale or mirror a selection and save the file
cmd.copy: Duplicate entities with a cumulative offset and save the file
cmd.array: Duplicate entities into a rectangular or polar array and save the file
cmd.explode: Replace one polyline with independent line entities and save the file
cmd.measure: Measure bounds, path length and enclosed area of a drawing file
cmd.add-line: Add a line and save the file in place
cmd.add-circle: Add a circle and save the file in place
cmd.add-polyline: Add a polyline and save the file in place
cmd.add-text: Add single-line text and save the file in place
cmd.add-dimension: Add a linear dimension and save the file in place
cmd.delete: Delete one entity by id and save the file in place
cmd.list: List the entities of a drawing file
cmd.move: Move one entity by an offset or to an absolute point and save the file
cmd.update: Update text content/height or a circle radius and save the file
cmd.layer: Add and edit the layers of an existing drawing file
cmd.layer-add: Add a layer and save the file in place
cmd.layer-rename: Rename a layer, rewriting entity references, and save the file
cmd.layer-visible: Set a layer's visibility and save the file in place
cmd.layer-lock: Set a layer's lock state and save the file in place
cmd.layer-merge: Move every entity of one layer onto another and remove the empty source layer

opt.title: Drawing title
opt.template: Accepted for compatibility; no template is loaded yet
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: units, layers, geometry, polylines, dimensions, duplicate-entity, zero-length, open-contour (constraints and references are not implemented)
opt.format: Exchange format to write: dxf, step, stl, svg or pdf (step and stl extrude closed profiles)
opt.layer: Target layer id (defaults to 0; dimensions default to dimensions)
opt.center: Circle, arc or ellipse centre as x,y
opt.radius: Circle or arc radius in drawing units
opt.start-angle: Start angle in degrees (arcs are counter-clockwise)
opt.end-angle: End angle in degrees; defaults to a full turn
opt.rx: Ellipse radius along the major axis
opt.ry: Ellipse radius along the minor axis
opt.all: Select every entity in the drawing
opt.mirror: Mirror axis: x reflects across y=at, y reflects across x=at
opt.pivot: Rotation or scale pivot as x,y
opt.mirror-at: Coordinate of the mirror line on the mirrored axis; defaults to 0
opt.count: Number of copies or polar array items, 1-10000
opt.rows: Rectangular array rows including the source, 1-10000
opt.columns: Rectangular array columns including the source, 1-10000
opt.row-spacing: Vertical distance between adjacent array rows
opt.column-spacing: Horizontal distance between adjacent array columns
opt.total-angle: Polar array total angle in degrees; copies are placed counter-clockwise
opt.sheet: Sheets are not modelled; a non-empty value is rejected
opt.closed: Close the polyline back to its first vertex
opt.height: Text cap height in drawing units
opt.offset: Signed distance of the dimension line from the measured segment
opt.to-point: Absolute target point for the entity anchor as x,y
opt.name: Layer name, which also acts as the layer id
opt.locked: Layer lock state: on or off
opt.layer-from: Source layer whose entities move; the layer is removed after the merge
opt.layer-to: Target layer that receives the entities
